rounds.q: What did a classic Thanksgiving dinner for 10 cost in the US in 2025?
rounds.why: The exact total was $55.18, and the 16-lb turkey alone cost $21.50, about $1.34 a pound.
rounds.src: American Farm Bureau Federation, Thanksgiving Dinner Cost Survey (2025 data)
rounds.fun: A whole feast for 10 at about $55, and $21.50 of that was the turkey!

rounds.q: About how many hours should 4 to 5 lbs of turkey thaw in a fridge?
rounds.why: Thawing in cold water is faster, about 30 minutes per pound, if you change the water every 30 minutes.
rounds.src: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service, Turkey Basics: Safe Thawing
rounds.fun: A full day in the fridge for every 4 to 5 pounds. Turkeys are slow to wake up!

rounds.q: How many pounds of turkey does one American eat in a year?
rounds.why: The exact figure was 13.2 lbs in 2025, down from 15.7 lbs per person in 2020.
rounds.src: USDA Economic Research Service, Turkey Sector Background Statistics (2025 data)
rounds.fun: About 13 pounds of turkey per person a year, a bit less than the 15.7 back in 2020!

rounds.q: What % of US cranberries are grown in Wisconsin?
rounds.why: That's its typical share. Massachusetts is second at about 25%, and a barrel of cranberries is 100 lbs.
rounds.src: USDA Economic Research Service, Charts of Note: cranberry crop (2025)
rounds.fun: Around 60% of the cranberries come from Wisconsin. The cranberry sauce has a hometown!

rounds.q: How many turkeys did US farms raise in 2025?
rounds.why: The exact count was 193.5 million, and Minnesota raised the most of any state, about 33.5 million.
rounds.src: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service, Turkeys Raised (2025 estimate, Sept 2026 report)
rounds.fun: About 194 million turkeys in one year, and 33.5 million of them came from Minnesota!
